metadata.title: Alibaba Stock: The AI Rally Isn’t Over, It’s Just Moved to China<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The AI Stock Rally Isn’t Over— It’s Just Moved to China
Online retailer Alibaba was leading a Chinese tech rally on Wednesday, as investors carried on ditching U.S. and South Korean memory-chip makers.
